paper_title: Deepest sensitivity to wavelike dark photon dark matter with superconducting radio frequency cavities
notes: Proof-of-concept nontunable SRF cavity (QL=4.7e9) dark photon haloscope at Fermilab SQMS (SERAPH). Excludes kinetic mixing chi > 1.5e-16 at 90% CL for m_A' = 5.354 ueV (f0 = 1.2946 GHz). Single-frequency measurement; exclusion spans only a few kHz around resonance (roughly -3.5 to +0.5 kHz, i.e., ~-14 to +2 peV around 5.354 ueV), so a single point at the resonant mass is emitted. Assumes randomly polarized DP, standard halo model, rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Deepest wavelike DPDM exclusion at time of publication.
